card.title: WASHINGTON
card.text: Washington DC played a vital role in the United States planning and preparation for WWII.
card.flavorText: Washington DC, the capital of the US, went through a drastic transformation during WWII. As the government grew during the war the population of the city nearly doubled and hundreds of new government facilities were built around the city. The majority of the new government workforce were women as the men were sent off to combat in Europe and the Pacific. Washington was never attacked during the war, and was never at risk, but the military did put up some anti-aircraft guns in the city just to be safe.
